A four-parameter development-trained perceptron observing ONLY public affine anchors through episode3 may or may not predict which fixed remaining schedule reduces unseen later errors; since onset4..7 is causally absent from episode3 history, unearned future-event prediction should not be attributed to the learned selector.

Compare matched full eight-episode mismatches, worst regime, exact 10 landmark readings per trial, causal feature equivalence, false reset and churn. Preserve per-seed negative and null results.

PARTIAL_SELECTION_GAIN iff learned pooled mismatches <0.99*min(fixed_A,fixed_B) and zero steady errors or false resets; NO_GAIN otherwise. Report paired-world same-feature conflicting training labels, model weights and exact provenance. Best-per-world oracle only as non-deployable diagnostic, never acceptable comparator.
